documents.title: US AirNow: ground-level ozone public-health guidance
documents.publisher: United States Environmental Protection Agency / AirNow
documents.scope: Ambient O3 guidance at an explicitly supplied US EPA AQI category; international reference in Israel.
documents.license: Original concise summary; no substantial source passages. Source copyright retained by its owner.

reviewed_actions.recommendation: If an authorized source explicitly reports ambient O3 using the US EPA AQI category Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, communicate the matching US AirNow advice to shorten and reduce outdoor activity intensity for ozone-sensitive groups, take breaks and follow existing asthma action plans.

documents.title: US AirNow: ambient nitrogen-dioxide public-health guidance
documents.publisher: United States Environmental Protection Agency / AirNow
documents.scope: Ambient NO2 near-roadway guidance at an explicitly supplied US EPA AQI category; international reference in Israel.
documents.license: Original concise summary; no substantial source passages. Source copyright retained by its owner.

reviewed_actions.recommendation: If an authorized source explicitly reports ambient NO2 using the US EPA AQI category Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, communicate the matching US AirNow advice that people with lung disease, children and older adults limit prolonged outdoor exertion, especially near busy roads.

documents.title: US EPA AirNow: ambient sulfur-dioxide public-health guidance
documents.publisher: United States Environmental Protection Agency / AirNow

reviewed_actions.recommendation: If an authorized source explicitly reports ambient SO2 using the US EPA AQI category Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, communicate the matching US AirNow advice that people with asthma consider limiting outdoor exertion.

documents.title: US EPA AirNow: ambient carbon-monoxide public-health guidance
documents.publisher: United States Environmental Protection Agency / AirNow

reviewed_actions.recommendation: If an authorized source explicitly reports ambient CO using the US EPA AQI category Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, communicate the matching US AirNow advice that people with heart disease limit heavy exertion and avoid high-CO settings such as heavy traffic.
